==== generated/broken-flavours.d/core/hello@server.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GENERATED FILE, do not edit.
set -euxo pipefail

MODDIR=/ctx/modules/core/hello
export MODDIR

if [ "${FLAVOUR:-}" != "server" ]; then
    echo "skipping core/hello: not built for '${FLAVOUR:-the ungated build}'"
    exit 0
fi
